datafield.subfield: Princeton University Library Collection of Dēmētrēs A. Charisiadēs Photographs,
Processing Information: This collection was processed and cataloged by Kalliopi Balatsouka in 2023. Finding aid written by Kalliopi Balatsouka in 2023.
The collection is open for research.
Open, growing collection of photographs of Greece by Greek photographer Dēmētrēs A. Charisiadēs.
Two photographs of Greece by Greek photographer Dēmētrēs A. Charisiadēs in 1950s comprise the collection.
